results.title: Old man possum
results.brief_description: Gives details of the animal, its characteristics and its food habits. Compares the Australian marsupial with the American opossum. Shows types of possums, including gliding phalangers of all sizes, the ring-tailed possum, the cuscus and many others. Also shows the research work on the physiology of marsupials being carried out on the brush-tailed possum at Sydney University.

results.title: Old dogs, new tricks
results.brief_description: You learn till you die … it’s the only way. Diminishing mental faculties are not a necessary outcome of old age. This heartening film focuses on a number of people for whom retirement and old age have only served as a springboard to new activities and skills. It clearly demonstrates that stimulation is an important part of keeping independent and motivated.

results.title: Old crafts new graces
results.brief_description:
Episode of Series “This Is Britain”.
Shows that, although the machine dominates the industrial scene of today, traditional British craftsmanship still plays an essential part in the production of certain goods. Examples illustrating such craftsmanship include: the making of a fishing rod; the work of the silversmith; skill with leather in the manufacture of saddles.

results.title: OK...Camera
results.creator_credit: Ian McLaren, ONF | NFB and Michael Rubbo
results.brief_description: Quebec produces many of the feature films made in Canada. The film looks at this unique, controversial industry; at the people who have succeeded in it (Genevieve Bujold is one) or failed; at its movies, which run the gamut from hard-core skinflicks to such highly acclaimed films as Mon oncle Antoine, and at its audiences, which number in the millions.
